claims.claim: Cameco raised its dividend after reporting a Q3 adjusted loss driven by transitory factors.
claims.episode_span: Cameco reported a Q3 adjusted loss driven by transitory factors yet still raised its dividend, signalling management confidence in future free cash flow despite the 25 percent year-to-date share-price drop.
claims.source_title: Cameco After a Q3 Loss and a Dividend Hike: Buy Now, Hold, or Wait?
claims.supporting_quote: Following a tough third quarter of results, many investors seem to be in a bit of a panic amid a seemingly perfect storm of selling pressures. The adjusted loss might be seen as a red flag by some, but, for the most part, the loss is an outlier due to a number of transitory factors and tougher comparables.

claims.claim: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share after guiding to a $70-$78 range, with trading set to begin November 19 under ticker ANT.
claims.episode_span: The company priced above the prior $70-$78 range and begins trading November 19 under ticker ANT, with strong oversubscription reported.
claims.source_title: Anthropic IPO price range still $70-$78, pricing tomorrow
claims.supporting_quote: Anthropic says there is no change to the pricing of its initial public offering. The company is still guiding to a range of $70 to $78 per share.
